label: Bible Study
prompt: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good _____, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verse: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
note: Pressed down, shaken together, running over — a grain-market picture of generous giving.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in _____, even as thy soul prospereth.
verse: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
note: John's friendly opener to Gaius — a first-century 'hope you're doing well,' body and soul alike.

label: Sunday School
prompt: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, _____ be thy name.
verse: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
note: 'Hallowed' means treated as holy — the Lord's Prayer honors God's name before making a single request.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Is there no _____ in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
verse: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
note: Gilead was famous for healing resin; Jeremiah asks why, with medicine nearby, his people stay sick — the spiritual answers 'There is.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a _____ in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verse: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
note: A psalm for the sons of Korah, whose clan really did keep the temple doors — and preferred it to wickedness's tents.
